functional.scope: Functional lifetime, forced serialized IRQ/NMI races, and eight-task allocation; no timing claims

observer.scope: Passive full-address CPU markers, POKEY timestamps and I-flag transitions between emulator microstates; no guest instructions/cycles added
observer.build_options: Same as toolchain/altirra-build.json, build/latency target AltirraBridgeServer
observer.resolution: I transitions sampled between CPU microstates, including RTI followed immediately by IRQ. 1/8 base-cycle timestamps at 8x; includes NMI/ROM/DMA elapsed time. Not a hardware worst-case guarantee.

bank_zero.accounting: Computed from current build maps, full DP/stack guards, complete near-data/manifest arenas, four-task table arena slack (1024 bytes total), and retained 240-byte old context arena. Eight-task totals use generated bank_zero_budget. Heap native helpers fit the existing 4096-byte upper reservation; no new bank-zero arena.

limits: Four-task generated-byte TX pump; no RX, turnaround, queued driver, DOS or physical-hardware qualification.
Eight-task cases are functional only; concurrent baud qualification stays deferred.
I=1 callers and forced race stalls are excluded from the timing workloads.
Observed maxima are not global bounds. Long serialized scans can postpone a worker while IRQ refill continues.
A masked interval can contain the refill itself, so it is not equivalent to ready-to-refill latency.
